cover_headline: Dallas BAPS Mandir Expects 12,000 for Diwali Annakut and Fireworks on November 10
facts: The BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Irving expects roughly 12,000 visitors for its Diwali and Hindu New Year celebration on Tuesday, November 10, from 3:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m.
The centrepiece is the Annakut, an offering of hundreds of vegetarian dishes prepared by devotees, alongside an exhibition titled "Light Beyond Lamps: Journey Through Hindu Sanskruti"
BAPS Charities will make a food donation to Irving Cares as part of the event; its Dallas-area drive for the same nonprofit collected about 2,000 pounds of food in October 2025

end.headline: Dallas BAPS Mandir Expects 12,000 for Diwali Annakut and Fireworks on November 10
end.line: The Irving mandir's Diwali and Hindu New Year celebration on November 10 pairs the Annakut offering and a 'Light Beyond Lamps' exhibition with fireworks and a BAPS Charities food donation to Irving Cares.
